doc.title: Christine Jensen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 4, 2024

title: Closing remarks and goodbyes
summary: Rowe thanks her and wishes her well; they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I want to wish you best of luck in your continued composing and playing and educating and all of that, and I really appreciate your time today.
Thank you. You inspire me by asking questions. Sometimes I’m like I don’t know what I’m doing.
Sounds to me like you know what you’re doing.
All right. I hope to cross paths with you sometime.
Yes. Look me up if you’re in the neighborhood.
